description:

A Acoem é um grupo global que transforma dados em valor para preservar o meio ambiente e aumentar a confiabilidade de ativos. A Acoem Brasil atua nas divisões de Meio Ambiente monitoramento de Ruído e Vibração, Qualidade do Ar, Gás, Partículas) e Confiabilidade Industrial (Manutenção Preditiva, Monitoramento de Condição e Alinhamento a Laser). Nosso trabalho é fornecer Produtos e Serviços de alta tecnologia para monitoramento, calibração e análise, atendendo indústrias e setores que buscam conformidade legal e otimização de ativos.  Principais Responsabilidades  Planejar, supervisionar e distribuir as atividades diárias da equipe técnica (Analistas e Técnicos), acompanhando o andamento das ordens de serviço.  Garantir a qualidade e segurança nos atendimentos técnicos de manutenção, instalação, calibração e suporte.  Otimizar o planejamento operacional, recursos, equipamentos e deslocamentos, visando a eficiência e o custo-benefício.  Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para solução de problemas técnicos complexos e promover a transferência de conhecimento na equipe.  Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (SLA, tempo de resposta) e propor ações de melhoria contínua dos processos.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Formação Mínima: Graduação completa em Engenharia (Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Ambiental ou afins) ou Gestão de Processos Industriais.  Experiência em atividades técnicas de campo, manutenção ou calibração de equipamentos, com pelo menos 1 ano em funções de coordenação ou supervisão.  Conhecimento avançado em manutenção, calibração e instalação de equipamentos de manutenção preditiva (Vibração, Alinhamento a Laser, Monitoramento de Condição - CMS), equipamentos de monitoramento ambiental ou sistemas correlatos.  Domínio de ferramentas de controle operacional (sistemas de gestão de ordens de serviço, ERPs).  Desejável: Conhecimento em gestão de contratos de manutenção e SLA, e Inglês técnico. Ability to review initiatives, understand detailed business processes and technology, and make timely decisive decisions. Track record of being a change agent, one who can drive new and commercial thinking across the organization and the behaviors supporting such, while engaging in a collaborative, inclusive style Strategic, analytical, and creative thinking style with a realistic, pragmatic approach  Education Bachelor’s degree in information/computer science, engineering, or related discipline with IT focus required.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. FactSet participates in E-Verify. FactSet is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity. title: Principal DevAx Solutions Architect, AGS Tech Field LATAM PACE
description:
Nova oportunidade para Principal DevAx Solutions Architect, AGS Tech Field LATAM PACE em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Description  Developers and development teams are key influencers who steer organizational adoption of new technologies, services, and platforms. The mission of the Developer Acceleration (DevAx) team within PACE is to help developers gain greater familiarity and confidence building AI/Agentic applications, and to accelerate the path from prototype to production at scale. As a Principal DevAx Solutions Architect within PACE  you will be at the forefront of emerging technology adoption, with a particular focus on Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-native application architectures. You will help customers understand and harness the transformative potential of services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Nova, and Frontier Agents, translating these forefront capabilities into practical, production-ready solutions that address real business problems. You will continuously sharpen and apply your expertise in the full AI development lifecycle to upskill developers and development teams on AWS services. You will be  a trusted advisor with proven technical expertise developing full-stack solutions on AWS, sharing recommendations around system and application architectures, security and cost considerations, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency to accelerate customers’ most challenging, mission-critical projects. Internally  you will be the voice of the customer. You will synthesize observations from customer engagements and market trends around custom-developed and AI-native workloads to inform the roadmap of AWS service teams. Key job responsibilities Own the end-to-end path to production for AWS built prototypes, partnering with Prototyping Architects, customer engineering teams, and field stakeholders to ensure prototypes successfully transition from proof-of-concept to production-grade, scalable solutions on AWS driving measurable business outcomes for customers. Lead large-scale, cross-organizational developer enablement initiatives that drive measurable adoption of Agentic AI, AI/ML, and modern application development on AWS. Design and build industry-significant reference architectures and developer-focused solutions that become recognized patterns across the community. Decompose complex developer transformation challenges into scalable, reusable approaches. Influence C-level and senior engineering leadership on how GenAI can drive organizational change. Mentor and develop senior Prototyping Architects and DevAx practitioners. Lead cross-functional hiring, contribute to thought leadership through publications, conference talks, and community engagement. Surface strategic product feedback to engineering and PM teams.  About The Team The Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE) team is an elite group of hands-on builders within AWS. Through rapid, time-boxed prototyping engagements, PACE helps customers explore the art of the possible with AWS, turning bold ideas into working solutions that demonstrate real business value. PACE operates at the frontier of emerging technology, with deep expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI/MAL, and modern agentic application development. Basic Qualifications 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications Experience with AI/ML technologies  Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud  Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit  for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Company – Amazon AWS Services Brazil Ltd   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Bolsista Doutor - Akiyama -  Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria  | Do[...]
description:
Nova oportunidade para Bolsista Doutor - Akiyama -  Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria  | Do[...] em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial  oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável . Sobre a Oportunidade: Akiyama é referência nacional no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de identificação e segurança, com soluções inovadoras que atendem a setores como segurança pública, bancos, empresas privadas e órgãos governamentais. Nosso foco é criar produtos de alto desempenho em biometria, inteligência artificial e segurança da informação, sempre impulsionando a inovação e a transformação digital. Estamos buscando um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nosso time de P&D, contribuindo no desenvolvimento de soluções que combinam computação quântica, IA e cibersegurança aplicadas à biometria. Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo  nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica, Física Aplicada, ou áreas correlatas. Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Projeto: Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria Principais Atividades: Propor arquiteturas híbridas (clássica + quântica) para otimização de tempo de processamento em sistemas biométricos; Simular hardware quântico ou utilizar computadores quânticos reais em nuvem (IBM Quantum, D-Wave, Rigetti, entre outros); Aplicar criptografia, física computacional, inteligência artificial e cibersegurança aos produtos da empresa.  Conhecimento necessário: Criptografia quântica e algoritmos pós-quânticos (ex.: Lattice-based cryptography); Computação quântica: modelos de computação (gate-based, annealing), uso de Qiskit ou similares, circuitos quânticos e simulação de algoritmos; Machine Learning e Deep Learning aplicados à biometria; Experiência com bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch) e frameworks quânticos (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane). Inglês Avançado.  Conhecimento desejável: Processamento de sinais biométricos (impressões digitais, face, íris, palma da mão, voz, etc.); Conhecimento em teorias de informação e codificação para proteção de templates biométricos (ex.: cancelable biometrics, fuzzy extractors).  Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial Formato de trabalho : Híbrido Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Principal Cloud Architect
description:

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.Cloud has and remains a core enabler for several of our enterprise strategies: rounding the corner on Digital Transformation, executing on M&A, driving Investment Programs, and enabling GenAI. The Platform Infrastructure Engineering Team at FactSet is looking for an additional member for the Cloud Architecture team. The team is comprised of Cloud Architects and Engineers, focusing on overall Cloud Architecture strategy & execution, and enablement of the organization to create and run optimized Cloud Native solutions on GCP and AWS. The **Principal Cloud Architect** will help maximize the benefit FactSet receives from its usage of public cloud.  The architect will directly contribute to the growth of the business by partnering with Strategic Business Units and Engineering teams to promote modernization, leveling up Cloud knowledge, increasing collaboration across the organization and helping to realize FactSet’s Cloud Architecture strategy.**Responsibilities:*** Supports the planning and implementation of enterprise Cloud Programs* Make meaningful contributions to FactSets cloud platform and capabilities.* Fosters a culture of innovation and encourages colleagues to think differently in finding solutions.* Focuses on providing efficient business value; ensuring programs are delivered as efficiently as possible.* Work with other Platform Infrastructure Engineering teams to help drive adoption of cloud services.* Ensures core FactSet Infrastructure services are available in the cloud and easily consumable by FactSet engineering teams.* Increase velocity of cloud migration and digital transformation by helping engineering teams adopt DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and automated release processes.* Work with FactSet security organization to ensure a strong security posture of services and data in the cloud.* Provide input and assistance on high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) of services running in the cloud. Develop processes and tooling to help engineering teams implement these HA & DR strategies for critical services deployed in the cloud.* Identify and implement cost optimization strategies for cloud services.* Periodic on call and occasional weekend work**Minimum Requirements:*** 7 or more years of hands-on public cloud experience successfully making architecture contributions in a fast-paced, high growth business with demonstrable experience leading cross-functional technology teams, planning, capital expense budgeting, and process improvement.**Critical Skills:*** 5+ years GCP experience working in a highly distributed fast paced environment.* Leadership experience* Proven track record of being an innovative and pragmatic technology expert.* Understanding of Cloud Computing technologies.* Strong Working knowledge of one or more of the following: Python, GoLang, Terraform, or Ansible* Experience with Docker, GKE, Serverless (Cloud Run / Lambda)* Strong foundational knowledge on GCP and AWS Networking services: VPC, NCC, Cloud Interconnect, TGW, Direct Connect, ILB/ALB/NLB, PrivateLink* Knowledge of Generative AI and AI/ML tools & techniques* Strong desire for learning new tech and solving challenging engineering problems.**Additional Skills:*** Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead business and technology discussions at all levels.* Ability to review initiatives, understand detailed business processes and technology, and make timely decisive decisions.* Track record of being a change agent, one who can drive new and commercial thinking across the organization and the behaviors supporting such, while engaging in a collaborative, inclusive style* Strategic, analytical, and creative thinking style with a realistic, pragmatic approach**Education:*** Bachelor’s degree in information/computer science, engineering, or related discipline with IT focus required. *At FactSet, we celebrate diversity of thought, experience, and perspective. We are committed to disrupting bias and a transparent hiring process.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. FactSet participates in E-Verify.*FactSet is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity**Company Overview:**FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at  and follow us on  and . At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.#J-18808-Ljbffr

The Red Hat Sales team is looking for a Senior Account Solution Architect to join us in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. In this role, you will be helping our customers accelerate their business with Red Hat’s hybrid cloud offerings through technical presentations and solution demonstrations.  You’ll build relationships with customers, account managers, and product teams to design and architect new solutions using the leading enterprise Kubernetes platform, built for managing hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, and edge-network deployments. Red Hat OpenShift is optimized to improve developer productivity and promote innovation while facilitating the management of increasingly complex environments.  As a Senior Account Solution Architect, you’ll demonstrate the ability to connect technology with measurable business value for customers across many industries, ranging from medium to large businesses.  You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges to drive revenue growth and Red Hat awareness together with our partners.  What You Will Do   Support the aligned sales team;  Continuously grow and expand knowledge of Red Hat’s offerings and solutions;  Guide customer interaction and critical business relationships, grow your network, and work on your ability to motivate executives;  Facilitate the technical relationship between Red Hat and our customers;  Discover opportunities and present technical solutions to customers aligned with their business goals;  Provide technical sales support and architect solutions that include Red Hat’s offerings, consulting services, and training;  Build relationships with customers and partners to gain an extensive understanding of their business and IT environments, allowing the sales team to best match Red Hat’s offerings and solutions to address customer needs and requirements;  Support customer meetings through presentations like whiteboarding or formal presentations, demonstrations, and explanations of the value of Red Hat’s technologies and architected solutions;  Guide engaging conversations, customer relationships, and architecture solutions that result in sales growth;  Communicate progress, status, and lessons learned from sales pursuits to all internal stakeholders and customers as applicable.    What You Will Bring   Able to conduct and articulate complex Application and Solution Architecture discussions leveraging microservices cloud architecture, and cloud-native practices;  Good knowledge of and experience with DevOps; knowledge of cloud architectures in general;  A proactive approach to building technical relationships with our partners;  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English;  Good documentation skills and experience presenting to mid to large‑sized audiences;  Effective persuasive and negotiation skills; ability to gain agreement among our stakeholders;  Exceptional organizational and planning skills with the ability to work on multiple projects at the same time;  Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to work well in a team environment;  Experience with container platforms like Kubernetes;  Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent experience.    The Following Are Considered a Plus   Experience with Container Services offerings through Cloud Providers, including but not limited to: AWS EKS, AWS Fargate, Azure AKS, Google GKE, AWS ROSA, Azure ARO, Azure DevOps;  Previous experience in application modernization projects leveraging Public or Private Cloud infrastructure;  Experience with Docker;  Understanding of industry trends around cloud computing, end‑user computing, development platform, or virtualization;  Experience with security;  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift;  Experience with Red Hat Application Services offerings and technologies;  Cloud certifications. title: Chief technology officer - cto
description:
Confira a vaga para Chief technology officer - cto em blumenau. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Purpose of the Position  The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading Saa S platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.  More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.  Main Challenges and Assignments    Modernize without disruption:  Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle +. NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.   Act as the Integrator of the EOS model:  Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.   Professionalize the technology organization:  Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.   Build cohesion and leadership depth:  Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.   Sustain high performance and growth:  Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.   Influence and earn autonomy:  Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.   Drive engagement and culture:  Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.   Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders:  Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.  Prepare for scale and possible M&A:  Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.    Experience and Professional Qualifications    Technology leadership:  Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in Saa S, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.   Transformation delivery:  Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).   Systems architecture expertise  : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (. NET Framework,. NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).   Operational excellence:  Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).   Process & governance:  Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.   Stakeholder management:  Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.   Team scaling & culture:  Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.   Language:  Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.  Education:  Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.    Behavioral Skills    Ownership & Accountability  – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.   Transparent & Courageous Communication  – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.   Learning Agility & Adaptability  – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.   Executive Presence with Simplicity  – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.   Collaborative Influence  – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Secretário(a) executivo(a)
description:

✨ Vaga: Secretário(a) Executivo(a) Pleno(a) | Blasi Advocacia  ✨    O Blasi Advocacia  é um escritório consolidado e respeitado, reconhecido pela excelência e inovação em suas áreas de atuação. Contamos com uma equipe de advogados dedicados e um ambiente de trabalho pautado pela ética, colaboração e busca constante por resultados de alta qualidade.    Estamos em busca de um(a) secretário(a) executivo(a) pleno(a)  para integrar nosso time, assumindo um papel fundamental no apoio administrativo e operacional do escritório, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência e o sucesso de nossas operações.    Se você é uma pessoa organizada, proativa e apaixonada por oferecer suporte de alta qualidade em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, esta oportunidade é para você!  Sobre a Posição:   O(a) profissional será o braço direito da nossa equipe jurídica e da gestão, garantindo o bom funcionamento das atividades administrativas, a organização impecável do escritório e o suporte estratégico necessário aos nossos advogados. Sua atuação será vital para otimizar o tempo da equipe e assegurar um fluxo de trabalho contínuo e eficiente.  Suas Principais Atribuições:   Gestão de Agendas e Compromissos:  Gerenciamento proativo e organização detalhada da agenda dos advogados, incluindo o agendamento de reuniões, audiências, videoconferências e compromissos externos, utilizando ferramentas como Google Calendar ou sistemas de gestão específicos, garantindo a otimização do tempo e o cumprimento de prazos judiciais e extrajudiciais.  Comunicação e Atendimento:  Filtragem e gestão de chamadas telefônicas, contatos pelo Whats App e e-mails, identificando prioridades, direcionando-os aos responsáveis e prestando informações a clientes, tribunais e parceiros, sempre com discrição e cordialidade.  Organização e Arquivamento de Documentos:  Implementação e manutenção de um sistema eficiente de organização e arquivamento de documentos, tanto físicos quanto digitais. Isso inclui a gestão eletrônica de documentos, assegurando a fácil localização, a integridade das informações e a conformidade com as políticas de segurança da informação e a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD).  Elaboração e Revisão de Documentos:  Redação, formatação e revisão de correspondências, atas de reunião, relatórios gerenciais, petições simples, procurações e outros documentos administrativos e jurídicos, garantindo clareza, correção gramatical e alinhamento com os padrões do escritório.  Gestão de Suprimentos e Orçamentos:  Controle do estoque de suprimentos de escritório, realizando cotações e gestão de pequenos orçamentos para aquisições, garantindo a disponibilidade de materiais e a otimização de custos.  Apoio em Viagens Corporativas:  Organização completa de viagens corporativas para a equipe, incluindo reservas de passagens aéreas e terrestres, hospedagens, translados e preparação de itinerários detalhados.  Recepção e Experiência do Cliente:  Recepção e atendimento de excelência a clientes, visitantes e fornecedores, garantindo uma primeira impressão positiva e um ambiente acolhedor e profissional.  Preparação de Materiais:  Suporte na preparação de materiais para reuniões internas e externas, apresentações (Power Point) e organização de eventos do escritório.  Manutenção do Ambiente:  Contribuir ativamente para a manutenção de um ambiente de trabalho organizado, funcional e produtivo.     Habilidades e Competências que Buscamos:   Experiência Comprovada:  Mínimo de 3 (três) anos de experiência sólida e comprovada como Secretário(a) Executivo(a) ou Assistente Administrativo(a) sênior, preferencialmente adquirida em escritórios de advocacia, consultorias ou ambientes corporativos de alta demanda, onde a confidencialidade e a precisão são cruciais.  Organização e Gestão do Tempo:  Capacidade excepcional de planejar, priorizar e executar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente, gerenciando prazos apertados com eficiência e mantendo um alto nível de organização em todas as atividades.  Comunicação Exímia:  Excelente comunicação interpessoal, verbal e escrita, com clareza, concisão e profissionalismo, capaz de interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, clientes de alto perfil e autoridades.  Proatividade e Iniciativa:  Habilidade de antecipar necessidades, identificar problemas e propor soluções de forma autônoma, demonstrando iniciativa para otimizar processos e agregar valor ao dia a dia do escritório.  Discrição e Confidencialidade:  Essencial para lidar com a natureza sensível das informações jurídicas e pessoais de nossos clientes, aderindo rigorosamente aos princípios da LGPD e ao código de ética profissional, mantendo a mais alta confidencialidade.  Domínio Tecnológico:  Proficiência avançada no Pacote Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Teams), com habilidade para criar documentos, planilhas para relatórios e apresentações impactantes. Familiaridade com ferramentas de videoconferência (Zoom, Google Meet) e sistemas de gestão de processos jurídicos (CRM jurídico) ou plataformas de automação de escritório é um diferencial.  Orientação para Resultados:  Foco em otimizar processos, identificar gargalos e contribuir ativamente para a eficiência geral do escritório, buscando sempre a melhoria contínua.  Resiliência e Flexibilidade:  Capacidade de se adaptar rapidamente a novas demandas, lidar com situações imprevistas e manter a calma e a produtividade sob pressão.  Atenção aos Detalhes:  Rigor e precisão na execução de todas as tarefas, desde a revisão minuciosa de documentos até a organização de agendas, garantindo a ausência de erros e a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade.     O Que Oferecemos:   Salário competitivo e alinhado com o mercado.  Ambiente de trabalho desafiador, colaborativo e de alto desempenho.  Oportunidade de fazer a diferença em um escritório de advocacia de referência, com 70 (setenta) anos de mercado, com impacto direto na operação.  Desenvolvimento profissional contínuo, com acesso a treinamentos e programas de capacitação.  Cultura organizacional que valoriza a ética, a inovação e o bem-estar de seus colaboradores.     Se você se identifica com esta oportunidade e deseja fazer parte da equipe do escritório Blasi Advocacia, envie seu currículo e carta de apresentação detalhando suas experiências e por que você seria o(a) candidato(a) ideal para esta posição para.  Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e sua paixão por excelência!

title: Líder de vendas
description:
Nova oportunidade para Líder de vendas em ribeirão preto. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Vaga: Líder de Vendas — Performance Comercial  Sobre a L4 S  A L4 S é uma empresa de tecnologia para o mercado imobiliário, especializada em soluções que ajudam imobiliárias a gerar mais visibilidade, organizar leads, acelerar atendimento e aumentar performance comercial.  Estamos em fase de crescimento e estruturação do nosso time comercial, com foco em mais previsibilidade, método, execução e alta performance.  Buscamos uma pessoa para assumir a posição de Líder de Vendas, atuando diretamente na rotina comercial, desenvolvimento do time e acompanhamento dos indicadores de vendas.  ⸻  Sobre a posição  O Líder de Vendas será responsável por conduzir a execução diária do time comercial, garantindo ritmo, clareza de metas, gestão de pipeline, melhoria de abordagem e evolução dos indicadores de performance.  Essa pessoa terá um papel fundamental para transformar metas comerciais em rotina prática, apoiando o time de Inside Sales no acompanhamento de oportunidades, follow-ups, reuniões, propostas e fechamentos.  Mais do que cobrar resultados, buscamos alguém que saiba liderar pelo método, pelos dados e pelo desenvolvimento do time.  ⸻  Principais responsabilidades  * Liderar e acompanhar a rotina diária do time comercial.  * Garantir clareza de metas, prioridades e atividades do time.  * Monitorar indicadores de vendas, produtividade e conversão.  * Acompanhar pipeline, oportunidades abertas e propostas em andamento.  * Garantir disciplina no uso do CRM e atualização das etapas comerciais.  * Apoiar vendedores na melhoria de abordagem, pitch, follow-up e negociação.  * Identificar gargalos no funil comercial e propor ações corretivas.  * Realizar feedbacks individuais e coletivos com foco em desenvolvimento.  * Conduzir reuniões rápidas de alinhamento e performance.  * Acompanhar reuniões agendadas, realizadas, taxas de conversão e fechamentos.  * Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Operações, Pós-venda e Produto para garantir alinhamento entre venda e entrega.  * Reportar resultados, riscos e oportunidades para a diretoria.  ⸻  O que esperamos de você  * Experiência prévia com vendas internas, Inside Sales ou liderança comercial.  * Conhecimento de funil de vendas, CRM e indicadores comerciais.  * Capacidade de analisar dados e transformar números em plano de ação.  * Boa comunicação, organização e senso de prioridade.  * Perfil de liderança prática, com energia para puxar ritmo e desenvolver pessoas.  * Capacidade de cobrar com respeito, clareza e objetividade.  * Visão consultiva de vendas.  * Foco em resultado e melhoria contínua.  * Maturidade emocional para lidar com metas, pressão e diferentes perfis de vendedores.  ⸻  Será um diferencial  * Experiência com Saa S, tecnologia ou empresas B2 B.  * Vivência no mercado imobiliário.  * Experiência com times de SDR, Inside Sales ou vendas consultivas.  * Conhecimento em CRM como Pipedrive, Hub Spot, Leads4 Sales ou similares.  * Experiência com playbooks comerciais, cadências e gestão de pipeline.  ⸻  Indicadores acompanhados na posição  * Cumprimento da meta de vendas.  * Receita fechada pelo time.  * Número de contratos fechados.  * Reuniões agendadas e realizadas.  * Taxa de comparecimento nas reuniões.  * Conversão por etapa do funil.  * Conversão de reunião para venda.  * Produtividade por vendedor.  * Propostas enviadas e follow-ups realizados.  * Qualidade e atualização do CRM.  ⸻  Modelo de contratação  * Formato: Presencial  * Local: Ribeirão Preto/SP  * Regime: MEI  * Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, horário comercial  * Remuneração: Fixo + variável por performance, modelo OTE  ⸻  Perfil ideal  Buscamos uma pessoa com mentalidade de dono, foco em execução e capacidade de desenvolver um time comercial com método, disciplina e energia.  Essa posição é para quem gosta de vendas, números, rotina comercial, melhoria contínua e liderança de pessoas.  O desafio é fazer o time vender melhor, com mais previsibilidade, organização e consistência.

title: Gerente geral de propriedade
description:
Nova oportunidade para Gerente geral de propriedade em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você quer enfrentar novos desafios em uma indústria dinâmica? Você tem experiência liderando projetos onde teve que fortalecer as áreas de operações, comercial e atendimento ao cliente?Então, essa vaga é para você! Primeiro, nos apresentamos: Somos a Greystar, uma empresa com um modelo de negócio focado na gestão, desenvolvimento e investimento de apartamentos para aluguer totalmente equipados, com espaços comuns acolhedores e um serviço de administração profissional que é referência no mercado. Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base nos nossos pilares e valores; Nossos pilares nos orientam para "o que fazemos" e nossos valores norteiam "como fazemos". Hoje estamos em processo de crescimento no mercado brasileiro e por isso procuramos pessoas apaixonadas, dispostas a contribuir no que for necessário para alcançarmos juntos o melhor progresso. Você pode ser nosso próximo " Gerente de Propriedades" O que é ou faz um Gerente Geral de Propriedades? O Gerente Geral de Propriedade é uma função importante para nossas operações. É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Isto, a fim de alcançar um ótimo desempenho comercial e operacional. Estas podem ser suas funções: Liderar as equipes de atendimento ao cliente e manutenção. Preparação de relatórios financeiros para nossos investidores. Gestão de equipes, levando a promover a criação do melhor local para trabalhar. Elaboração e gestão de orçamentos. Gestão proativa dos índices de satisfação dos clientes: análise de informações, criação de planos, monitoramento. Planejamento de atividades para a comunidade. Gestão holística da manutenção predial. Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.  Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o "know-how" pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes. Pré-requisitos: Carreiras com foco em Hospitality. Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...) Experiência desejável nas áreas: Imobiliário, Multifamily, Hotelaria, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Empreendedorismo, etc... Inglês avançado. Utilização de ferramentas Office 365.  Se você está interessado, então o que está esperando?

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Empresa está contratando Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm) em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.  Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de inglês em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior backend (node.js) engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend (node.js) engineer em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILOset out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical Saa S solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its Saa S platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer , you'll bedesigning and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and buildingnew microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role. We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space –problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's afundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You'll Do: Architect and develop scalable Type Script microservices powering XILO's platform. You'll have theopportunity to work where your strengths shineand contribute to: AI Agents– Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing– Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping– Aggregating and linking all relevant data into acentralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM– The AI-powered backboneof agencies, seamlesslytracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflowswhile replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry– ATypeform-like systembuilt for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions –fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we're looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in Type Script and Java Script. Strong experience with Node.js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., Type ORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup– Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth– Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing– Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em são josé. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature Co Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em itatiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Analista de governança de dados sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de governança de dados sênior em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?Naredspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações. Seu papel no time: Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos. Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas. Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências. Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres. Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo). Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA. O que você traz na bagagem (Requisitos): Sólida experiência em Catalogação de Dados , gestão de metadados e glossários. Domínio de processos de Data Quality(limpeza, padronização e monitoramento). SQL Avançadopara Data Profiling e análise de inconsistências. Conhecimento profundo dos princípios do DAMA-DMBOK. Excelente capacidade de documentação técnica para diferentes públicos. Diferenciais que valorizamos: Experiência com ferramentas de mercado (Apache Atlas, CKAN, Purview ou similares). Vivência em projetos com foco em LGPD e Privacy by Design. Conhecimento em arquitetura Lakehouse ou modelagem semântica. Inovação com IA: Interesse em usar IA Generativa para automatizar metadados e documentação. Experiência com dados do setor público ou ambiental (CAR, SIGEF, INCRA) será um baita diferencial!Por que a redspark? Se você busca um ambiente que valoriza a maturidade técnica, a autonomia e que entende que a Governança é a chave para o futuro da IA, seu lugar é aqui. Pronto(a) para elevar o nível dos nossos dados?

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Business development representative
description:
Empresa está contratando Business development representative em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We Master Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets. Responsibilities: • Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives. • Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact. • Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals. • Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies. • Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform. • Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue. • Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems. • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies. Qualifications: • 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles. • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). • Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills. • Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously. • Experience using CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce). • Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation. • Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage. What We Offer: • Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives • Ongoing professional development and career growth • Collaborative and international work environment • Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems Job Type : Full-Time / Remote Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ruby on rails engineer em porto alegre. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Stay Fi Stay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business. Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industryin a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.
