This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Nova oportunidade para Implementation analyst em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: Implementation Analyst English Resume Only Location: Brazil Type: Full-Time Contract Setup: Fully Remote Level: Mid-Level Industry: Software SAAS Company Shift: US Hours Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer Equipment: Available upon request Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge. About the Opportunity Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption. The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience. Responsibilities Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients. Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations. Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability. Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments. Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health. Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability. Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles. Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms. Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously. Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
Nova oportunidade para Strategic partnership & alliance em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Rate Gain Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em são leopoldo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em mogi das cruzes. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas. Responsabilidades Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes; Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes; Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos; Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas; Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes; Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.); Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio; Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades; Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV); Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV); Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.); Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas; Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais; Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes; Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores); Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções; Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil; Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local; Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro; Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades; Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes; Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar; Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial; Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica; Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico; Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos; Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst; Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação; Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV); Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point; Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica; Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade; Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades; Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural; Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Trabalho em equipe; Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta); Senso de urgência; Multitarefa; Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios; Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em cotia. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior ruby on rails engineer em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Stay Fi Stay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business. Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industryin a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em atibaia. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Confira a vaga para Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess em porto alegre. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas. Responsabilidades Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes; Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes; Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos; Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas; Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes; Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.); Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio; Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades; Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV); Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV); Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.); Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas; Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais; Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes; Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores); Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções; Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil; Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local; Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro; Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades; Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes; Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar; Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial; Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica; Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico; Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos; Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst; Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação; Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV); Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point; Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica; Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade; Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades; Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural; Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Trabalho em equipe; Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta); Senso de urgência; Multitarefa; Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios; Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em itapevi. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores); Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções; Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil; Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local; Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro; Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades; Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes; Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar; Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial; Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica; Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico; Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos; Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst; Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação; Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV); Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point; Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica; Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade; Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades; Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural; Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Trabalho em equipe; Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta); Senso de urgência; Multitarefa; Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios; Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: ️ accounting manager
description:
Empresa está contratando ️ accounting manager em sorocaba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

This role is for the person who: Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials. Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on. Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience. To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for. About Up Counting We're afully remote, tech-poweredfirm helpinge Commerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence. Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus. We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department. We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work. We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA. What You'll Be Doing Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work. Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files. Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed. Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations. System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment. High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus). Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you. Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes. Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes. FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset. A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement. Perks & Culture Because great work deserves a great place to do it. Fully Remote + Async Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap. Work from Anywhere We care about outcomes, not location. Paid Time Off Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure. Grow With Us We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact. Continuous Learning We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning. Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market. Your Journey at Up Counting Your First Week Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones. Month 1 You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate. In 3 Months You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity. Curious About Our Values & Culture? They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page. How We Hire Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human: Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video. Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations. Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team. Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership. Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait. No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

description:

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: ️ accounting manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para ️ accounting manager em vinhedo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

This role is for the person who: Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials. Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on. Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience. To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for. About Up Counting We're afully remote, tech-poweredfirm helpinge Commerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence. Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus. We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department. We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work. We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA. What You'll Be Doing Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work. Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files. Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed. Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations. System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment. High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus). Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you. Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes. Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes. FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset. A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement. Perks & Culture Because great work deserves a great place to do it. Fully Remote + Async Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap. Work from Anywhere We care about outcomes, not location. Paid Time Off Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure. Grow With Us We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact. Continuous Learning We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning. Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market. Your Journey at Up Counting Your First Week Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones. Month 1 You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate. In 3 Months You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity. Curious About Our Values & Culture? They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page. How We Hire Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human: Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video. Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations. Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team. Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership. Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait. No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

description:
Nova oportunidade para Fx trader em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ruby on rails engineer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Stay Fi Stay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business. Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industryin a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui.   Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança   Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes    PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT?  Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores. title: Analista De Custos Sr
description:

Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox's Burton's Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.  A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets, Yogurte 100, Pettiz e Disqueti.   Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS, Brach's, Jelly Belly, SweeTARTS, Laffy Taffy, and Trolli. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry's.   Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.   Sobre a vaga   O Analista de Custos Sr para fornecer suporte operacional e financeiro crítico à planta, atuando como parceria diária à equipe de operações, a fim de impulsionar melhorias de classe mundial em processos e contribuir com controles e análises mais assertivos e estratégicos.   Localidade: Rolândia - PR   Reporta a: Coordenador de Custos / Controller   Modelo de trabalho: Presencial   Contamos com você para:   Apoiar a liderança da planta na gestão do desempenho operacional, integrando finanças, produtividade e eficiência;   Conduzir planejamento, forecast e análises financeiras, incluindo acompanhamento de despesas vs. orçamento, identificação de desvios e oportunidades de redução de custos;   Preparar, analisar e comunicar relatórios financeiros, operacionais e executivos, com comentários acionáveis e visão prospectiva;   Desenvolver e monitorar KPIs e modelos financeiros, destacando tendências e suportando decisões estratégicas da planta;   Garantir governança, controles internos e acuracidade de dados no SAP, assim como de inventário, listas técnicas, percentuais de perda e roteiros;   Participar de projetos relacionados na manufatura e auditorias externas, promovendo excelência operacional e melhorias de processos de classe mundial.    Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:   Formação superior concluída em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;   Conhecimentos em SAP, Excel e Power Point ao nível avançado;   Inglês avançado, com habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, é desejável;   Experiência prévia em finanças industriais;   Disponibilidadede trabalho em Rolândia – PR.    O que nós oferecemos:   Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:   Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)  Assistência médica   Assistência odontológica   Dr Dori (telemedicina)  Seguro de vida   Totalpass   Refeitório no local   Vale alimentação   Vale Natal   Vale transporte   Descontos em produtos    Igualdade de Oportunidades   Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.   A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC  ).   Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.
